finding_summary: At pinned apache/flink-connector-kafka commit dc707db60fcf3c0637114503c27685c881519c2c, AdminUtils.getOpenTransactionsForTopics resolves topic metadata and active producer IDs before invoking Admin.listTransactions filtered by those producer IDs and TransactionState.ONGOING; its exception path explicitly mentions Kafka broker >=3.0 and read permissions on target topics.
scope_guard: Pinned AdminUtils.java only; no claim about Kafka broker/RPC implementation, ListTransactionsOptions empty-filter semantics, runtime scheduling, actual authorization policy, topic-to-producer uniqueness, other versions, or other writers.
residual_richer_mode_protected_manual_de: The inspected mechanism requires an executing Kafka Admin client plus reachable broker/topic authority and is not a zero-residual scheduled-Chat route.
finite_monthly_quota_dependency: none implicated or consumed for evidence gathering; no claim that Kafka infrastructure is quota-free
exact_next_action: Fresh-bootstrap next invocation, then inspect exactly one official Apache Kafka ListTransactionsOptions source/API family compatible with the pinned Flink connector to determine the semantics of filterProducerIds when given an empty producer-ID collection. Preserve API/source-version scope; do not infer broker behavior beyond the documented or source-visible contract. This tests whether the Flink AdminUtils path can broaden scope when no active producer IDs are found.
